Helicopter UH-1D 66-00819

Unit: A/101 AVN
Incident number: 69060444.KIA
UTM grid coordinates: BT266225 (map lookup key: Grid Reference 49PBT266225)
Date: 06/04/1969
South Vietnam
Summary: An unidentified explosive round hit it; it crashed and all five passengers died.
War Story: An operations report says that at 1455H a UH-1H of A/101 AHB near BT265125 was hit by an unidentified explosive round and crashed, killing all five aboard. Minutes later a call confirmed that aircraft 66-00819 had crashed and was burning. We flew straight out to the site.
